subject: Boston Stand-Up Comedy
overview: Host Stevie B interviews Boston stand-up comedians Ricky Antonellis and Christian Trotta about their comedic styles, stage experiences, and the local comedy circuit. The episode features stand-up clips from both guests along with previews of their upcoming performances.

items.title: Guest Introductions
items.summary: Host Stevie B welcomes Boston stand-up comedians Ricky Antonellis and Christian Trotta to the show.

items.title: Beginnings in Stand-Up and Influences
items.summary: Antonellis and Trotta discuss entering stand-up comedy through mentor Vinny Favorito and cite influences including Eddie Murphy, Don Rickles, and Dave Chappelle.

items.title: Stand-Up Clip: Ricky Antonellis
items.summary: Antonellis sets up and airs a clip from a stand-up performance opening for Frank Santorelli focusing on medical exams.

items.title: Unusual Shows and Handling Hecklers
items.summary: The comics share memories of performing in unusual settings, including a goat farm, and explain their different approaches to handling hecklers.

items.title: Stand-Up Clip: Christian Trotta
items.summary: Trotta introduces a clip of his performance in Glens Falls, New York, featuring celebrity impressions of Barack Obama and Arnold Schwarzenegger.

items.title: The Boston Comedy Scene
items.summary: Antonellis and Trotta examine the gritty reputation of Boston audiences and promote their monthly show at the Fisherman's Club in the North End.

items.title: Rapid-Fire Questions
items.summary: Stevie B conducts a fast-question segment covering favorite local spots, memorable audience reactions, and navigating shifting standards in modern comedy.

items.title: Upcoming Projects and Closing
items.summary: The guests discuss plans to start a comedy night in East Boston, provide social media contact details, and conclude the interview.
